text:
anna: FYI new hire hit a nasty combo: yarn workspace + edge function -> resolved CJS entry + duplicated types + broken auth retries.
anna: error in Cloudflare dev: 
`The requested module "/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/cjs/index.cjs" does not provide an export named "default"`
ben: classic story: bundler picked the CJS path even though dist/esm exists. Which package.json exports shape do we have?
owen: our SDK exports currently have both import and require. snippet: 
```json
{"exports":{".":{"import":"./dist/esm/index.mjs","require":"./dist/cjs/index.cjs"}},"types":"./dist/index.d.ts"}
```
frida: edge runtimes (esbuild for workers) sometimes prefer `require` if mainFields prioritization is wrong. yarn classic hoisting + workspace symlinks can cause two physical copies which also leads to duplicate global state.
tyler: that explains the auth retry flakiness — second requests lose Authorization because the retry middleware lives on different SDK instance. we saw this in another mono repo.
anna: repro steps posted in the onboarding issue. quick repro: yarn workspace, sample worker imports `@redwood/sdk`, build with wrangler -> fails.
ben: short-term fixes for the team:
- force bundler alias: `alias: {'@redwood/sdk': path.resolve(__dirname, '../node_modules/@redwood/sdk/dist/esm/index.mjs')}`
- set esbuild/webpack `mainFields` to prefer `module`/`browser` over `main`
- for TS dup types: `skipLibCheck: true` or add root `paths` to map `@redwood/sdk` -> hoisted types
owen: we patched a dev-only global attach to share auth: `globalThis.__rw_auth__ = globalThis.__rw_auth__ || new AuthClient(opts)` — opt-in and guarded. fixed retries for us.
frida: long-term SDK changes proposed:
1) publish a single ESM-first entry and add `browser` field pointing to ESM bundle
2) exports map that prioritizes `import`/`browser` before `require`
3) build a flattened `index.d.ts` so workspaces don't pick up duplicate declarations
4) add dev-only detection warning when SDK instance count >1 (console.warn with stack traces)
tyler: also need to audit for `node:` builtins in SDK that break in edge (e.g., `node:buffer`, `node:events`). Either tree-shake them or provide tiny polyfills for edge builds.
anna: CI note: our integration tests didn't catch this because they run in Node, not edge. we should add a small smoke test that bundles the sample worker with esbuild and ensures no CJS entry selected.
ci-bot: opened issue #914: "devex: edge/sdk-workspace-resolution-typing" and attached repro tarball. Labels: devex,sdk,monorepo,edge.
ben: docs action items: update quickstart with workspace troubleshooting section: hoisting checks (`yarn why`, `ls node_modules/@redwood/sdk`), bundler mainFields example, alias snippet, tsconfig `paths` example, and recommended package.json `exports` example.
owen: SDK action items: prioritize ESM-first packaging, publish flattened d.ts, add optional `attachGlobalAuth()` helper, and add dev warning for duplicate loads.
frida: security note: if we add global attach for auth, document it's dev-only and opt-in; don't change default behavior without vetting.
tyler: for immediate onboarding friction, I'll add a one-liner in quickstart: "If you use yarn workspaces, add an alias to force the ESM entry and set skipLibCheck until SDK patch ships."
anna: new dev got unblocked after alias + skipLibCheck. please capture steps in onboarding guide. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
